identity.title: APEX-SEPIA660 Early Science: gas at densities above 10<SUP>7</SUP> cm<SUP>-3</SUP> towards OMC-1

paper_type_evidence.quote: We have mapped the central part of the OMC-1 region with the new Swedish-ESO PI instrument for APEX (SEPIA) (cite: BEL18) installed at the APEX-12m telescope in Chajnantor (Chile).
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA#2015.1.00669.S.

targets.name: OMC-1 (Orion BN/KL, OMC-1 Ridge, OMC-1 South)

question.value: What are the densities of the star-forming gas in OMC-1 near the Orion Nebula Cluster, probed by N2H+ (7-6) at 652 GHz with APEX-SEPIA660 and compared with ALMA N2H+ (1-0)?

evidence.quote: We investigated the density properties of the star-forming gas in the OMC-1 region located in the vicinity of the Orion Nebula Cluster (ONC).
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA#2015.1.00669.S.

frequencies_and_spectral_setup.value: N2H+ (7-6) 652095.865 MHz and C18O (6-5) 658553.278 MHz, 240 kHz (0.11 km/s) native resolution, 8 GHz bandwidth, XFFTS backend (APEX SEPIA660)

evidence.quote: observed simultaneously with a native spectral resolution of 240 kHz (or 0.11 km s$^{-1}$) thanks to the large instantaneous bandwidth (8 GHz) of the new SEPIA660 receiver connected to an XFFTS backend
We convolved our N$_2$H$^+$ (7–6) and C$^{18}$O (6–5) datasets into a uniform Nyquist sampled grid with a final resolution of 10 arcsec.
well above the noise level our our data with $<rms> \sim 0.65$ K

evidence.quote: We combine four on-the-fly (OTF) maps covering a total area of $\sim 450 \times 200$ arcsec$^2$

method.value: Extract, reduce and combine OTF maps in GILDAS/CLASS, convolve to 10 arcsec, baseline subtract, convert to Tmb with eta_mb=0.4

method.value: Single Gaussian fit to each N2H+ (7-6) spectrum

evidence.quote: We fitted all our N$_2$H$^+$ (7–6) spectra using a single Gaussian velocity component.

evidence.loc: Gas at densities $>10^7$ cm$^{-3}$ in OMC-1

validation.value: Gaussian peak temperatures agree with full-hyperfine predictions within <=15%

evidence.quote: our gaussian fits accurately reproduce the line peak temperatures of the observed N$_2$H$^+$ (1–0) and (7–6) spectra within $\le$ 15%

method.value: RADEX grid in density 1e5-1e8 cm^-3 for TK=15, 25, 35 K, compared with observed Tmb(7-6) and the 7-6/1-0 ratio

evidence.quote: Our models include three representative gas kinetic temperatures, namely, $T_\mathrm{K}=$ 15 K, 25 K, and 35 K

findings_qualitative.value: N2H+ (7-6) emission is extended, avoids hot BN/KL, and is anticorrelated with C18O (6-5), which traces warm low-column gas

evidence.loc: 3 Dense gas exposed to the ONC
evidence.quote: we find no significant N$_2$H$^+$ (7–6) emission at the position of the hot Orion BN/KL region

claims.hypothesis: Does OMC-1 contain parsec-scale gas at n(H2)>1e7 cm^-3?
claims.experiment: Mapped N2H+ (7-6) with SEPIA660 and compared with ALMA (1-0) using RADEX models
claims.result: Observed Tmb and the 7-6/1-0 ratio are reproduced only by n(H2)>5e7 cm^-3
claims.finding: Large reservoirs of gas at n>1e7 cm^-3 exist near the ONC

evidence.quote: can only be reproduced if the gas detected in N$_2$H$^+$ (7–6) is at densities n(H$_2$) $> 5\times 10^7$ cm$^{-3}$

limitations_admitted.value: Single-component RADEX without hyperfine structure, extrapolated collisional rates, factor 3-5 density uncertainty; first-order estimate only

evidence.quote: Our analysis focuses on a simplified description of the N$_2$H$^+$ (1–0) and (7–6) peak temperatures ($T_\mathrm{mb}$) meant to obtain a first order approximation

referee_caveats_inferred: Densities rest on a single-component, one-column-density RADEX model with no uncertainty propagation
Beam filling and the 10 arcsec versus ALMA resolution matching are not discussed
Mass estimate method is not described

reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: small (<1 GB) for SEPIA data; ALMA N2H+ (1-0) cubes several GB
reproducibility.score_reason: APEX data and RADEX setup are described but the ALMA part is inherited and the mass estimate is vague.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: The main data are APEX SEPIA660 observations, and the ALMA role is a comparison with previously published data.
